code:
name: Release
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm publish --workspace @northwind/ui
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run test:visual
